info.title: PRISM Data Quality Checker — proposed API
info.description: Frontend contract templates only. No HTTP endpoints are currently implemented. Examples are synthetic, not model accuracy results. Schemas marked as existing models reuse Python records; other resources are planned. Local CPU prototype; plain text guidelines first.

ConfirmationState.description: Reviewer confirmation state for a rule or rulebook.
ConfirmationState.title: ConfirmationState

Rule.description:
A proposed or reviewer-confirmed requirement, separate from its check.

Parameters contain JSON-compatible values, such as allowed labels or
thresholds. An unknown or absent check name is permitted so unsupported
requirements can be retained. Extracted rules require an exact citation;
reviewer-authored rules may have no source sentence.
Rule.title: Rule

RuleOrigin.description: Whether a rule was extracted from text or authored by a reviewer.
RuleOrigin.title: RuleOrigin

Rulebook.description:
Group rules with their original plain text guidelines and a version.

Citation matching is exact and does not alter the supplied text. A
confirmed rulebook contains at least one rule, all confirmed. Rules
rejected during review can remain in a draft or an earlier saved version.
Confirmation fields record state; the review service manages reviewer
actions and appends attributed revisions without changing older versions.
Rulebook.title: Rulebook

BoundingBox.description: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax], one-based and inclusive. Source data may be invalid; display integrity results.

RulebookReplace.description:
Replace the complete draft contents, including individual rule decisions.

Omitted rules are removed. New IDs must use reviewer origin; retained IDs
preserve their origin. Confirmation states are explicit reviewer decisions.
RulebookReplace.title: RulebookReplace

RulebookAction.description: Identify the reviewed version and the person submitting the action.
RulebookAction.title: RulebookAction

RulebookReviewRecord.description: Attribution for one new snapshot, assigned by the backend.
RulebookReviewRecord.title: RulebookReviewRecord
